commitments.detail: Isolate Pump P-1 to prevent cross-contamination.
Commit to isolating Valve V17 for the duration of the temporary connection.
Document the cooling plan and required controls for the temporary chiller.
Ensure hoses are clear of all obstructions and maintain a clearance of at least 1.5 meters.
Assign a fire watch for the installation area during the setup and operation of the temporary chiller.
Document the route of the hoses to ensure they do not interfere with other operations.
